label: 📞 Normalize phone (E.164)
description: Parse a free-form phone-number column to canonical E.164 (e.g. `+15551234567`). Adds two columns: the normalised form and a boolean `valid` flag. Use the country hint when input numbers are formatted nationally without a country code.

default_country.label: Default country (ISO 3166 alpha-2)
default_country.help: Used when numbers don't include a + prefix. e.g. US, GB, DE, FR, IN.
